sentence: Discharge instructions arrive when patients are exhausted, and one unclear line can stall recovery.
Homeward turns the saved record into a plan Alex can follow.
View source opens the exact sentence behind each step.
Alex asks what paperwork to bring, and source search answers with the cited passage.
The lab instruction names no test or date, so Alex asks for help.
The care team replies, and the task stays open until the details are confirmed.
A reminder waits for Alex's approval.
When the response is lost, Retry safely returns the original receipt, so no second reminder appears.
The agent activity log records every step.
Four role-scoped specialists select references, and the server validates patient, record version, and approval.
All 32 guardrail checks pass, alongside 59 backend tests and four interface journeys.
Uncertainty stays visible, and every instruction keeps its source.
